title: A receipt cancel that got no answer is shown as money taken and waiting to send
what: When the owner cancels a receipt and the internet drops before the gym server answers, the cancel is kept on the device to send later. The Today line then says that amount 'in 1 payment taken on this device is waiting to send', the waiting list shows it as 'Payment (not confirmed yet)', and the Clear this device warning counts it as a payment. No money was taken: it is a cancel.
expected: A waiting cancel is shown as a cancelled receipt and is left out of the money waiting to send.
how_often: rarely (a receipt cancelled while the internet drops)
fix_line: Skip cancelled receipts when adding up the money waiting, and name them as cancels in the list

items.reason: This area only stores and moves records; every screen, export and HQ count reads the same gym records rows. Facts made here: money waiting to send (Today line, waiting list, Clear device warning, Staff screen), support access lines, PIN and device lines. Crispy Curves holds 3 members, 2 plans sold, 2 receipts, 0 cancelled, 2 check-ins, so a recount there proves nothing; no ugly data pack exists in the repo (could not compare on it).
Rule applied: the Clear device warning counts refused items but leaves their cash out (same fault as refused cash dropping out of money counts); a waiting cancel counted as money.

Date numbers here: support access spans (capped at 60 minutes by the server, so no long gap), PIN-lock and code-expiry clocks, and the demo gym's built dates. The demo never makes someone who joined today (1 to 730 days ago) or a plan that starts later, so it cannot show those edges; times by computer clock already a finding.
Rule applied: no number in this area found wrong at a date edge beyond the existing clock-zone finding.

Summaries with their own rows: money waiting (count and total) beside the waiting list; import preview receipts and money beside the import rows. The import preview runs the real import on a scratch copy, so it matches; the waiting total counts cancelled receipts that the list rows call payments. No summary here drops over time.
Opened the store and helper files that make numbers: outbox, cloud desk state, import preview, demo builder, support access words.

Money waiting: number from the waiting summary, rows from the waiting list (two functions). Import preview: number and saved rows both from the same import code (online import runs the same browser code per batch).

The two waiting functions differ on what they count (summary skips refused items and counts any receipt record, list shows every item and the first receipt); a long gap does not apply as neither uses dates. Import preview is one function.
